answers.question: What does my plan look like over the next few months?
answers.text:
Your long-term plan spans 12 weeks across 5 phases, from Monday, August 31 through Sunday, November 22. You are currently in the Base phase, which runs from Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13. The next phase starts on Monday, September 14.

The phases are:

- Base: Monday, August 31 to Sunday, September 13 (2 weeks). You start with short walk-run blends to build a consistent foundation for your first 5K.
- Build: Monday, September 14 to Sunday, October 4 (3 weeks). You extend the jogging portions within your walk-run outings to build endurance.
- Recovery: Monday, October 5 to Sunday, October 11 (1 week). A lighter week helps you absorb the progress you have made without losing your routine.
- Build: Monday, October 12 to Sunday, November 15 (5 weeks). You return to building endurance with renewed energy and slightly harder walk-run work.
- Maintain: Monday, November 16 to Sunday, November 22 (1 week). You maintain your hard-earned 5K readiness with steady walks and light jogging.

And week by week:

- Week 1, starting Monday, August 31 (Base): key session Run/walk (run). You start with short walk-run blends to build a consistent foundation for your first 5K.
- Week 2, starting Monday, September 7 (Base): key session Easy (walk). The focus stays on comfort as your walks and easy jogs begin to feel repeatable.
- Week 3, starting Monday, September 14 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). You extend the jogging portions within your walk-run outings to build endurance.
- Week 4, starting Monday, September 21 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). Your body adapts to sustained efforts with recovery built into each session.
- Week 5, starting Monday, September 28 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). You practice the rhythm you want for a 5K finish while keeping every effort controlled.
- Week 6, starting Monday, October 5 (Recovery): key session Recovery (walk). A lighter week helps you absorb the progress you have made without losing your routine.
- Week 7, starting Monday, October 12 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). You return to building endurance with renewed energy and slightly harder walk-run work.
- Week 8, starting Monday, October 19 (Build): key session Run/walk (run). Confidence grows as your jogging segments become a natural part of each outing.
- Week 9, starting Monday, October 26 (Build): key session Long (run). You practice covering more time on your feet with a mix of walking and relaxed jogging.
- Week 10, starting Monday, November 2 (Build): key session Intervals (run). You sharpen the walk-run strategy you will rely on for your first 5K.
- Week 11, starting Monday, November 9 (Build): key session Long (run). You bring your walk-run skills together in sessions that feel manageable.
- Week 12, starting Monday, November 16 (Maintain): key session Easy (run). You maintain your hard-earned 5K readiness with steady walks and light jogging.
